versions.changelog: v1.0.1 — Fix: corrected shared inbox domain from agents.commune.email to commune.ai. Fixed openclaw install command URL. All curl examples and quickstart now accurately reflect the production API.

v1.0.0 — Initial release. Full curl-based API reference covering all 50+ endpoints: domains, inboxes, threads, messages, semantic search, triage (tags/status/assign), structured extraction schemas, attachments, delivery metrics, webhooks, DMARC, agent self-management, Ed25519 agentless registration, and data deletion. Includes 60-second quickstart and email-as-memory patterns.
